_comment: Per testing-spec §1.12: quarterly mutation-testing health check on this crypto-adjacent library. NOT in PR CI — Stryker is slow (~10-30 min). Run via `npm run mutate` from this package directory; surfaces a Stryker HTML report. Threshold of 80% mutation score is a target, not a gate. Below 80% triggers a tracking issue.
testRunner_comment: Vitest's stryker plugin: runs the existing vitest config per mutant. No extra setup needed.
thresholds_comment: break:0 means Stryker never fails its run on score alone — surface, don't gate. low:70 turns the report yellow; high:90 turns it green.
incremental_comment: Stores results in .stryker-tmp/incremental.json so subsequent runs only mutate changed files.
